releases.notes:
### **Sorry to keep you waiting! (shameless reference)**

New Features:
 - The way Tile Sources are set has been overhauled, and you no longer need to manually edit a file to change them; they are now referred to as Rasters and have a configuration screen
 - The map now supports overlay layers, which can have custom opacities, be toggled in visibility, and be layered in any order
 - The search menu now saves search history for photon searches 

Minor Changes/Features:
 - Custom player icon for freecam
 - Base raster selection includes presets that can be used without having to create a custom one
 - Search menu locations now show as pins on the map, and can be selected
 - More webmaps have been added to right click menu, and they are now toggleable
 - A number of menus have been made scrollable, including search, pinned waypoints, webapp selection, and waypoint icon selection
 - An option is now available to translate /tp commands into /tpll commands when coming from any source, which can enable other /tp-reliant mods to work on BuildTheEarth servers
 - Option for the square buttons to use generated textures instead, making them compatible with resource packs 
 - Added an option to show hidden claims from the BuildTheEarh claim map
 - The /omm distortion command can now take a location argument
 - The bug report button has been removed and replaced with a wiki link, while the old wiki link has been replaced with creator attribution

Fixes:
 - Fullscreen map interface has been adjusted to properly show long attribution strings
 - Fixed map navigation errors when using multiple navigation methods (eg. mouse vs keyboard) at once
 - Claims will now always be visible at any zoom level they are supposed to be, instead of arbitrarily disappearing
 - Other minor fixes

Languages:
 - Only English translations are complete for new features, future minor versions will include translations once they are provided.

Version Support:
 - 1.8.0 will be the last major release to support Minecraft Versions 1.21.4 - 1.21.9. The next major release will only support versions 1.21.10+

### **Patch for v1.6.3**
**Final release for Minecraft versions 1.21.1 - 1.21.3**

Minor Changes:
 - Waypoints can now be right clicked for the context menu on the waypoint screen
 - Added local search, which uses your current map position to refine search results
 - Changed waypoint screen to use default minecraft scrolling elements

Languages:
 - Completed support for Traditional and Simplified Chinese

readmeSummary: Note that the map is specifically designed only to work with the BuildTheEarth modified dymaxion projection; the map will not work correctly with any other projection.
